# The command line of agentd (refactor plan S8, invariant I14), written by
# TestCLI in cmd/agentd/cli_test.go; regenerate with
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./cmd/agentd -count=1 -run '^TestCLI$'
# (only UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 regenerates; any other value compares).
# One run with an empty environment but for the env lines below and fresh
# $HOME and $XDG_CONFIG_HOME directories; $BINDIR is the binary's
# directory and $TMP the working directory.
$ agentd -h
env OPENV_API_URL="https://api.example.test"
env WORKER_API_KEY="wk-example"
env AGENT_CONCURRENCY=" 3"
env AGENT_CHILD_CONCURRENCY="0"
env AGENT_WORKSPACE_RETENTION="90m"
env RUNNER_POOL_KEY="pk-example"
env RUNNER_POOL="gpu"
env RUNNER_NODE_NAME="node-a"
env RUNNER_SESSION_ROOT="/srv/openv/sessions"
env OPENV_HOSTED="TRUE"
exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of agentd:
  -api string
    	OpenV API base URL (default "https://api.example.test")
  -child-concurrency int
    	extra slots reserved for child/interview runs
  -concurrency int
    	concurrent normal runs (default 1)
  -hosted
    	token-mode hosted runner: no CLI sign-in, no repo-access runs
  -mcp-binary string
    	path to the openv-mcp binary (default "$BINDIR/openv-mcp")
  -node-name string
    	stable name for this pool node (default: hostname) (default "node-a")
  -pool string
    	pool this node belongs to (default "default") (default "gpu")
  -pool-key string
    	transient runner pool key: run as a pre-warmed pool node instead of a fixed runner (default "pk-example")
  -session-root string
    	parent directory for per-lease HOME directories (pool mode) (default "/srv/openv/sessions")
  -worker-key string
    	worker API key (required) (default "wk-example")
  -workspace-retention duration
    	how long finished run workspaces are kept before cleanup (default 1h30m0s)
  -workspaces string
    	base directory for run workspaces (default "$HOME/.openv/workspaces")
